{{Quote|I admit, I am a bit concerned about our present situation.''"<br />"''We've been in worse.''"<br />"''Name one.''"<br />"''The Moons of Aldin.''"<br />"''Name two.|Kit Fisto and Mace Windu|audio=MoonsOfAldin-TCWRH.mp3|<ref name="TCW">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Republic Heroes]]''</ref>}}
The '''Moons of Aldin'''<ref name="TCW" /> were located in the [[Aldin system/Legends|Aldin system]] of the [[Aldino sector/Legends|Aldino sector]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Two [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]]&mdash;the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] and the [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]]&mdash;once had an unpleasant, dangerous experience at the [[Moon/Legends|moons]]. The pair later recollected the experience at the [[Battle of Juma 9]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] while fighting against waves of [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Sabotage droid/Legends|sabotage droids]].<ref name="TCW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Moons of Aldin were mentioned in the [[2009]] video game ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Republic Heroes]]''.<ref name="TCW" /> The [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the 2009 reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Aldin [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the moons, in grid square J-17.<ref name="EAOC" />
